name: Gosalyn Mallard - The Quiverwing Quack
en:
HEROIC INTERVENTION When you play this
character, you may ready chosen character
with cost 2 or less. If you do, they can't quest or
challenge for the rest of this turn.
zh: 英勇援助　當你打出這個角色時，你可以準備一個費用 2 或以下的指定角色。若你這麼做，該角色本回合剩餘時間內不能探險或挑戰。

name: Monterey Jack - Watchful Ranger
en:
BIRD'S-EYE VIEW When you play this character,
you may reveal the top card of your deck. If it's
a character card, you may put it into your hand.
Otherwise, put it on the bottom of your deck.
zh: 鳥瞰視野　當你打出這個角色時，你可以展示你牌庫頂的卡片。若它是角色卡，你可以將它加入手牌；否則，將它放到你牌庫底。

name: Dale - Excited Friend
en:
LOOK WHAT I FOUND While you have a character
named Chip in play, this character gets +1 ◊.
zh: 你看我找到什麼　當你有一個名為 Chip 的角色在場時，這個角色獲得 +1 ◊。

name: Pedro Madrigal - Family Patriarch
en:
DIFFICULT JOURNEY This character enters play
with 1 damage.
DEVOTED FAMILY When you play this character, if
you have another Madrigal character in play, you
may remove up to 1 damage from him.
zh:
艱難旅程　這個角色進場時帶有 1 點傷害。
忠誠家族　當你打出這個角色時，若你有另一個 Madrigal 角色在場，你可以從他身上移除至多 1 點傷害。

name: Agustin Madrigal - Exceptionally Kind
en:
Support (Whenever this character quests, you may
add their ¤ to another chosen character's ¤
this turn.)
zh: 支援（每當這個角色探險時，你可以在本回合把其 ¤ 加到另一個指定角色的 ¤ 上。）

name: Alan-a-Dale - Loyal Bard
en:
Singer 4 (This character counts as cost 4 to
sing songs.)
zh: 歌手 4（這個角色視為費用 4 來詠唱歌曲。）

name: Dolores Madrigal - Hears Everything
en:
NO SECRETS When you play this character, look
at chosen opponent's hand.
zh: 毫無秘密　當你打出這個角色時，查看指定對手的手牌。

name: Rex - Protective Dinosaur
en:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play
exerted. An opposing character who challenges
one of your characters must choose one with
Bodyguard if able.)
RUN AWAY! During an opponent's turn, when this
character is banished, gain 1 lore.
zh:
護衛（這個角色可以橫置進場。挑戰你角色的對方角色，若有能力必須選擇具護衛的角色。）
快逃！　在對手的回合中，當這個角色被消滅時，獲得 1 點傳說。

name: Hamm - Piggy Bank
en:
LOOSE CHANGE ⟳ — You pay 1 ⬡ less for the
next character you play this turn.
zh: 零錢　⟳ — 你本回合打出的下一個角色少支付 1 ⬡。

name: Monterey Jack - Hypnotized by Cheese
en:
BREAK THE TRANCE This character can't quest
unless you have a character with 4 ⛉ or more
in play.
zh: 打破迷幻　除非你有一個 4 ⛉ 或以上的角色在場，否則這個角色不能探險。

name: Bo Peep - Caring Shepherd
en:
SOMEBODY DO SOMETHING! Your characters
named Woody gain Bodyguard. (An opposing
character who challenges one of your characters
must choose one with Bodyguard if able.)
zh: 快做點什麼！　你名為 Woody 的角色獲得護衛。（挑戰你角色的對方角色，若有能力必須選擇具護衛的角色。）

name: Chip - Retrieval Expert
en:
THERE YOU ARE! When you play this character,
you may return a character card with 4 ⛉ or
more from your discard to your hand.
FRIENDLY ASSIST Your characters named Dale
get +1 ⛉.
zh:
原來你在這！　當你打出這個角色時，你可以將一張 4 ⛉ 或以上的角色卡從棄牌堆移回手牌。
友情協助　你名為 Dale 的角色獲得 +1 ⛉。

name: Woody - Jungle Guide
en:
Shift 3 ⬡ (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of one of
your characters named Woody.)
LET'S GET MOVIN' Whenever this character quests, draw
a card. Then, you may play a character with cost 2 or less
for free.
EVERYONE GATHER 'ROUND Your other Toy characters
get +1 ⛉.
zh:
變身 3 ⬡（你可以支付 3 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Woody 的角色上。）
我們出發吧　每當這個角色探險時，抽一張牌。然後，你可以免費打出一個費用 2 或以下的角色。
大家集合　你其他的玩具角色獲得 +1 ⛉。

name: Isabela Madrigal - Such a Lovely Voice
en:
Singer 5 (This character counts as cost 5 to
sing songs.)
NEW MOTIF When you play this character, if you
removed 1 or more damage from one of your
characters this turn, gain 1 lore.
zh:
歌手 5（這個角色視為費用 5 來詠唱歌曲。）
新樂章　當你打出這個角色時，若你本回合從自己一個角色身上移除過 1 點或以上的傷害，獲得 1 點傳說。

name: Bullseye - Loyal Horse
en:
LET'S RIDE If you have a character named Woody
or Jessie in play, you pay 1 ⬡ less to play this
character.
zh: 一起騎吧　若你有一個名為 Woody 或 Jessie 的角色在場，你打出這個角色時少支付 1 ⬡。

name: Ariel - Curious Traveler
en:
FAMILIAR GROUND Whenever this character quests,
if you played another character this turn, chosen
opposing character can't challenge and must quest
during their next turn if able.
zh: 熟悉的領域　每當這個角色探險時，若你本回合打出過另一個角色，指定的對方角色不能挑戰，且在其下個回合若有能力必須探險。

name: Isabela Madrigal - Caring Cultivator
en:
Shift 4 ⬡ (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Isabela Madrigal.)
DO NO WRONG Whenever you remove damage
from one of your characters, gain 1 lore for each 1
damage removed.
zh:
變身 4 ⬡（你可以支付 4 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Isabela Madrigal 的角色上。）
毫無差錯　每當你從自己一個角色身上移除傷害時，每移除 1 點傷害就獲得 1 點傳說。

name: Jessie - Lively Cowgirl
en:
PART OF A FAMILY Whenever this character
quests, if you have 2 or more other Toy characters
in play, you may draw a card.
YODEL-AY-HEE-HOO! Whenever you pay 2 ⬡ or
less to play a card, chosen opposing character
gets -1 ¤ until the start of your next turn.
zh:
家族的一份子　每當這個角色探險時，若你另有 2 個或以上的玩具角色在場，你可以抽一張牌。
呦得咧嘿呼！　每當你支付 2 ⬡ 或以下打出一張卡時，指定的對方角色獲得 -1 ¤，直到你的下個回合開始。

name: Woody - Leader of the Toys
en:
LET'S GO HOME When you play this character,
look at the top 4 cards of your deck. You may
reveal a Toy character card or a location card
named Andy's Room and put it into your hand.
Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in
any order.
zh: 回家吧　當你打出這個角色時，查看你牌庫頂 4 張卡。你可以展示一張玩具角色卡或一張名為 Andy's Room 的地點卡並加入手牌。將其餘的以任意順序放到你牌庫底。

name: Dale - Ready for His Shot
en:
SPIKE SUIT During challenges, your characters
deal damage with their ⛉ instead of their ¤.
zh: 尖刺裝　挑戰時，你的角色以其 ⛉ 而非 ¤ 造成傷害。

name: Julieta Madrigal - Caring Baker
en:
RESTORING RECIPE When you play this character
and whenever she quests, you may remove up to
1 damage from chosen character or location.
zh: 療癒食譜　當你打出這個角色時以及每當她探險時，你可以從指定角色或地點身上移除至多 1 點傷害。

name: Pluto - Vigilant Traveler
en:
BEWARE OF DOG Whenever this character quests,
if you played another character this turn, chosen
opposing character gets -1 ¤ until the start of your
next turn.
zh: 小心惡犬　每當這個角色探險時，若你本回合打出過另一個角色，指定的對方角色獲得 -1 ¤，直到你的下個回合開始。

name: Mickey Mouse - Expedition Leader
en:
LONG JOURNEY This character may enter play exerted.
SECRET PATH While this character is exerted, whenever
one of your other characters quests, chosen opposing
character gets -2 ¤ until the start of your next turn.
zh:
漫長旅程　這個角色可以橫置進場。
秘密路徑　當這個角色橫置時，每當你另一個角色探險時，指定的對方角色獲得 -2 ¤，直到你的下個回合開始。

name: Chip - Team Player
en:
RANGER RESOURCEFULNESS When you play this
character, if you have another character with 4 ⛉
or more in play, you may draw a card.
zh: 游擊隊的機智　當你打出這個角色時，若你另有一個 4 ⛉ 或以上的角色在場，你可以抽一張牌。

name: Ranger Team-Up
en: Chosen character gets +¤ equal to their ⛉ this turn.
zh: 指定角色本回合獲得等同其 ⛉ 的 +¤。

name: This Growing Pressure
en:
(A character with cost 3 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Chosen opposing character can't challenge and must
quest during their next turn if able. Draw a card.
zh:
（費用 3 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
指定的對方角色不能挑戰，且在其下個回合若有能力必須探險。抽一張牌。

name: You've Got a Friend in Me
en:
(A character with cost 3 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Look at the top 4 cards of your deck. You may reveal
up to 2 Toy character cards and put them into your
hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in
any order.
zh:
（費用 3 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
查看你牌庫頂 4 張卡。你可以展示至多 2 張玩具角色卡並加入手牌。將其餘的以任意順序放到你牌庫底。

name: Metamorphosis
en: Shift a character from your discard for free.
zh: 免費從你的棄牌堆變身一個角色。

name: When You Need Help, Just Call
en:
(A character with cost 3 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
If an opponent has more characters in play than you,
you may play a character with cost 4 or less for free.
zh:
（費用 3 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
若對手在場的角色比你多，你可以免費打出一個費用 4 或以下的角色。

name: Safety Rope
en:
GRAB HOLD! When you play this item, you may put
a character card from your discard on the top of
your deck.
PACK IT UP At the end of your turn, you may banish
this item to draw a card.
zh:
抓緊！　當你打出這個物品時，你可以將一張角色卡從棄牌堆放到你牌庫頂。
收拾好　在你的回合結束時，你可以消滅這個物品來抽一張牌。

name: Andy's Room - Home Base
en:
ANDY'S FAVORITE While you have only 1 character here, they get +2 ⛉
and +1 ◊.
zh: Andy 的最愛　當你這裡只有 1 個角色時，他們獲得 +2 ⛉ 和 +1 ◊。

name: Mor'du - Wicked with Pride
en:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn
they're played.)
zh: 突襲（這個角色在被打出的回合就能挑戰。）

name: Alma Madrigal - Leading the Way
en:
PROTECTING THE FAMILY When you play this
character, if you have another Madrigal character
in play, you may exert chosen opposing character.
zh: 守護家族　當你打出這個角色時，若你另有一個 Madrigal 角色在場，你可以橫置指定的對方角色。

name: Snow White - Merry as the Morning
en:
CLARION CALL Whenever this character quests,
you may return chosen Seven Dwarfs character of
yours to your hand to draw a card.
NEVER FORGOTTEN During an opponent's turn,
when this character is banished in a challenge,
return this card to your hand.
zh:
嘹亮號召　每當這個角色探險時，你可以將你一個指定的七矮人角色移回手牌來抽一張牌。
永誌不忘　在對手的回合中，當這個角色在挑戰中被消滅時，將這張卡移回你的手牌。

name: Dopey - Drawn to Music
en:
TONGUE-TIED This character can't ⟳ to sing songs.
DISTANT MELODY Once during your turn, whenever
you play a song, this character gets +1 ◊ this turn.
zh:
結舌　這個角色不能橫置來詠唱歌曲。
遙遠旋律　你回合中一次，每當你打出一首歌時，這個角色本回合獲得 +1 ◊。

name: Bashful - Riding the Rails
en:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
zh: 迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）

name: Doc - Taking Notes
en:
SHARE KNOWLEDGE When you play this character,
if you have another Seven Dwarfs character or a
Princess character in play, draw a card.
zh: 分享知識　當你打出這個角色時，若你另有一個七矮人角色或一個公主角色在場，抽一張牌。

name: Sneezy - Startlingly Loud
en:
GESUNDHEIT When you play this character,
chosen character gets +1 ◊ this turn.
zh: 保重　當你打出這個角色時，指定角色本回合獲得 +1 ◊。

name: Ariel - Curious Traveler
en:
FAMILIAR GROUND Whenever this character quests, if you
played another character this turn, chosen opposing character
can't challenge and must quest during their next turn if able.
zh: 熟悉的領域　每當這個角色探險時，若你本回合打出過另一個角色，指定的對方角色不能挑戰，且在其下個回合若有能力必須探險。

name: Sleepy - Deep Sleeper
en:
PLEASANT DREAMS When this character is
banished, if you have a Seven Dwarfs or Princess
character in play, you may draw a card.
zh: 好夢　當這個角色被消滅時，若你有一個七矮人或公主角色在場，你可以抽一張牌。

name: Maleficent - Imperious Traveler
en:
HEED MY WORDS Whenever this character quests,
if you played another character this turn, you may
exert chosen opposing character.
zh: 聽我號令　每當這個角色探險時，若你本回合打出過另一個角色，你可以橫置指定的對方角色。

name: Alma Madrigal - Heart of the Family
en:
FIND A WAY Whenever this character quests,
move up to 1 damage from chosen character of
yours to chosen opposing character.
zh: 找到辦法　每當這個角色探險時，將至多 1 點傷害從你一個指定角色移到指定的對方角色。

name: Cruella De Vil - Judgmental Traveler
en:
YOU'RE OUT OF FASHION Whenever this character
quests, if you played another character this turn,
you may banish chosen damaged character.
zh: 你過時了　每當這個角色探險時，若你本回合打出過另一個角色，你可以消滅一個指定的受傷角色。

name: Frozone - Super Slick
en:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
zh: 迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）

name: Queen of Hearts - Impatient Traveler
en:
ROYAL COMMAND Whenever this character quests, if you
played another character this turn, chosen character gains
Rush this turn. (They can challenge the turn they're played.)
zh: 皇家號令　每當這個角色探險時，若你本回合打出過另一個角色，指定角色本回合獲得突襲。（他們在被打出的回合就能挑戰。）

name: Will o' the Wisp - Forest Spirit
en:
COME ON OUT When this character is banished in a
challenge, you may return this card to your hand.
zh: 出來吧　當這個角色在挑戰中被消滅時，你可以將這張卡移回你的手牌。

name: Cinderella - Resourceful Traveler
en:
THIS AND THAT Whenever this character quests, if you
played another character this turn, you may put the top card
of your deck into your inkwell facedown and exerted.
zh: 這個那個　每當這個角色探險時，若你本回合打出過另一個角色，你可以將你牌庫頂的卡牌面朝下並橫置放入你的墨水池。

name: Violet Parr - Learning New Powers
en:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
DEFLECT When you play this character, you may
move 1 damage from chosen character to chosen
opposing character.
zh:
迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）
偏轉　當你打出這個角色時，你可以將 1 點傷害從指定角色移到指定的對方角色。

name: Pocahontas - Steadfast Traveler
en:
WANDERING SPIRIT Whenever this character quests,
if you played another character this turn, return a
location card from your discard to your hand.
zh: 流浪之魂　每當這個角色探險時，若你本回合打出過另一個角色，將一張地點卡從你的棄牌堆移回手牌。

name: Mrs. Incredible - Super Stretchy
en:
FLEXIBLE THINKING At the start of your turn, you
may choose one:
• This character gains Evasive until the start of
your next turn. (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge them.)
• This character gets +1 ◊ this turn.
zh:
靈活思考　在你的回合開始時，你可以選擇一項：
• 這個角色獲得迴避，直到你的下個回合開始。（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰他們。）
• 這個角色本回合獲得 +1 ◊。

name: Lenny - Toy Binoculars
en:
TAKE A GOOD LOOK When you play this character,
chosen opponent reveals their hand and discards
an action card of your choice.
COMIN' UP FAST Once during your turn, whenever
you play an action, you may ready this character.
zh:
仔細看看　當你打出這個角色時，指定對手展示其手牌並棄掉一張你選擇的行動卡。
快速跟上　你回合中一次，每當你打出一個行動時，你可以準備這個角色。

name: Hamish, Hubert & Harris - Making Mischief
en:
STAY QUIET This character may enter play exerted.
CLEVER TRAP At the end of your turn, if this
character is exerted, chosen opposing character
can't ready at the start of their next turn.
zh:
保持安靜　這個角色可以橫置進場。
巧妙陷阱　在你的回合結束時，若這個角色橫置，指定的對方角色在其下個回合開始時不能準備。

name: Elinor - Bespelled Queen
en:
Challenger +2 (While challenging, this character
gets +2 ¤.)
zh: 挑戰者 +2（挑戰時，這個角色獲得 +2 ¤。）

name: Will o' the Wisp - Forest Spirit
en:
COME ON OUT When this character is banished
in a challenge, you may return this card to
your hand.
zh: 出來吧　當這個角色在挑戰中被消滅時，你可以將這張卡移回你的手牌。

name: Mickey Mouse - Experienced Traveler
en:
LIGHTING THE WAY Whenever this character
quests, if you played another character this turn,
you may draw a card.
zh: 照亮前路　每當這個角色探險時，若你本回合打出過另一個角色，你可以抽一張牌。

name: Dash Parr - Lava Runner
en:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn
they're played.)
RECORD TIME This character can quest the turn
he's played.
zh:
突襲（這個角色在被打出的回合就能挑戰。）
破紀錄　這個角色在被打出的回合就能探險。

name: Mirage - Super Recruiter
en:
BUSINESS ARRANGEMENT When you play this
character, if you have a Super or Hero character
in play, you may draw a card.
zh: 商業協議　當你打出這個角色時，若你有一個超級或英雄角色在場，你可以抽一張牌。

name: Woody - Jungle Guide
en:
Shift 3 ⬡ (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of one of
your characters named Woody.)
LET'S GET MOVIN' Whenever this character quests, draw
a card. Then, you may play a character with cost 2 or less
for free.
EVERYONE GATHER 'ROUND Your other Toy characters

zh:
變身 3 ⬡（你可以支付 3 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Woody 的角色上。）

大家集合　你其他的玩具角色獲得 +1 ⛉。

name: Edna Mode - Fashion Designer
en:
NO CAPES! When you play this character, you
may return chosen item with cost 2 or less to its
player's hand. If you do, its player draws a card.
MAKING SUPERS FABULOUS Whenever this
character quests, your Super characters get +1 ◊
this turn.
zh:
不准穿披風！　當你打出這個角色時，你可以將一個費用 2 或以下的指定物品移回其持有者的手牌。若你這麼做，該持有者抽一張牌。
讓超級英雄更出色　每當這個角色探險時，你的超級角色本回合獲得 +1 ◊。

en:

for free.
EVERYONE GATHER 'ROUND Your other Toy characters
get +1 ⛉.
zh:

song, your characters gain Ward until the start of
your next turn.
zh: 查看你牌庫頂 2 張卡。將一張加入手牌，另一張牌面朝下並橫置放入你的墨水池。若有角色詠唱了這首歌，你的角色獲得守護，直到你的下個回合開始。

name: Syndrome - Out for Revenge
en:
Shift 4 ⬡
GOT ME MONOLOGUING! Whenever this character
quests, return a Robot character card from your
discard to your hand. Then, you may play or shift a
Robot character with cost 8 or less for free.
zh:
變身 4 ⬡
讓我獨白了！　每當這個角色探險時，將一張機器人角色卡從棄牌堆移回你的手牌。然後，你可以免費打出或變身一個費用 8 或以下的機器人角色。

name: Mrs. Incredible - Determined Rescuer
en:
Shift 5 ⬡
PULL BACK Your characters gain Resist +1.
REGROUP During your turn, whenever another
character is banished in a challenge, you may ready
chosen Super character. If you do, they can't quest
for the rest of this turn.
zh:
變身 5 ⬡
拉回　你的角色獲得抵抗 +1。
重整　在你的回合中，每當另一個角色在挑戰中被消滅時，你可以準備一個指定的超級角色。若你這麼做，他們本回合剩餘時間內不能探險。

name: Touch the Sky
en:
Move a character of yours to a location for free.
Then, draw cards equal to that location's ◊.
zh: 將你一個角色免費移動到一個地點。然後，抽取等同該地點 ◊ 數量的牌。

name: Buzz Lightyear - Jungle Ranger
en:
Shift 5 ⬡
TAKE CHARGE When you play this character, you may
return an action card with cost 7 or less from your discard to
your hand.
ADVANCED TRAINING Whenever you play an action,
chosen character gets +1 ◊ this turn.
zh:
變身 5 ⬡
接手　當你打出這個角色時，你可以將一張費用 7 或以下的行動卡從棄牌堆移回手牌。
進階訓練　每當你打出一個行動時，指定角色本回合獲得 +1 ◊。

name: Merida - Formidable Archer
en:
FULL QUIVER When you play this character, you may
return an action card named Three Arrows from your
discard to your hand.
STEADY AIM Whenever one of your actions deals
damage to an opposing character, deal 2 damage to
that character.
zh:
滿箭袋　當你打出這個角色時，你可以將一張名為 Three Arrows 的行動卡從棄牌堆移回你的手牌。
穩定瞄準　每當你一個行動對對方角色造成傷害時，對該角色造成 2 點傷害。
